jd:
Technical Program Manager - Lattice Orchard Software

About the role
Lattice Orchard builds developer tooling. Program managers keep engineering, design and support aligned on a shared roadmap. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Own roadmaps spanning several engineering teams
- Run planning and track delivery risks
- Report progress to executives

Requirements
- Program management across multiple teams
- Stakeholder management
- Risk management
- Budget ownership
- Agile or Scrum delivery with software teams
- Jira administration

Nice to have
- PMP certification
- SQL

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
